created_for: Startup Sim Godot desktop tycoon HUD category, operation, and status icon expansion
storage_policy: Primary copy lives inside godot/StartupSimGodot/assets/art. External D:/美术资源/startup-sim copy is backup only.

source_tooling.generation: built-in imagegen through the image-2 art route
source_tooling.post_processing: Pillow atlas normalization, #ff00ff chroma-key removal, and 224/64/48 transparent icon slicing
source_tooling.transparency: generated on #ff00ff chroma-key and converted to RGBA alpha

texture_metadata_schema.id: stable texture identifier used by integration code
texture_metadata_schema.file_64: 64x64 transparent PNG path for HUD buttons
texture_metadata_schema.file_48: 48x48 transparent PNG path for compact HUD buttons
texture_metadata_schema.footprint_cells: logical gameplay occupancy in grid cells
texture_metadata_schema.visual_size_cells: approximate visual footprint for renderer scaling

textures.usage: 在 Startup Sim Godot 桌面版 HUD、对象面板或状态提示中作为“研发房间”图标使用。

godot_hint.sorting: Draw in CanvasLayer HUD or object panel controls; no world y-sorting required.

button_sizes.standard: Use file_64 for normal desktop HUD buttons.
button_sizes.compact: Use file_48 for dense object panels and table rows.
button_sizes.atlas: Use the 224px atlas cell if Godot theme scaling or shader treatment is preferred.

godot_hint.text_policy: No baked text; render all Chinese labels, numbers, KPI values, months, and names with Godot Label nodes. Use the label 现金流可支撑时间 for cash support time UI.
